story.fullStory:
Sir Mix-a-lot's "Jump On It" reached #97 on the Billboard Hot 100. Return of the Bumpasaurus is the fifth studio album by American rapper Sir Mix-a-Lot.

It was released on August 27, 1996, via American Recordings.

The recording sessions took place at Mix-a-Lot Studios in Auburn, with Chris Rock recorded live at The Comedy Store in Los Angeles on March 27, 1996.

The song peaked at #97 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 3 weeks on the chart.
